items.title: OpenAI Daybreak for NATO — allied cyber agencies get OpenAI's defense models
items.summary: NATO, ENISA and three national cyber agencies use OpenAI's Daybreak models to find and patch software flaws.

items.title: ChatGPT for Academic Researchers — OpenAI widens free access to 200,000
items.summary: OpenAI doubles its free ChatGPT program for scientists, but new grants give ChatGPT Plus instead of Pro.

items.title: OpenCode Browse — MCP server that lets agents use your real browser
items.summary: OpenCode Browse gives any MCP agent a real, signed-in Chromium browser to work in.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.326 — Code Mode works with agent teams, sandbox tightens
items.summary: Claude Code 2.1.326 brings Code Mode to agent teams and closes more paths from the shell to your credentials.

items.title: Sam Witteveen — 'ZGX Fury - How Fast Can it Go?'
items.summary: Sam Witteveen puts HP's ZGX Fury through speed tests and real local AI workloads.

items.title: Windows 11 Tracks Which Coding Agents You Run — Optional diagnostics report
items.summary: Windows 11 quietly notes which coding agents and dev tools run on your PC and reports it as optional diagnostics.

items.title: vLLM v0.34.0 — a bigger KV cache by default, and Model Runner V1 is gone
items.summary: vLLM v0.34.0 gives most models a larger KV cache by default and makes Model Runner V2 the only GPU runner.

items.title: ChatGPT for Healthcare agents — they click through hospital software
items.summary: OpenAI's healthcare agents read screens, click and type across hospital and insurer software, so staff hand off paperwork.

items.title: OpenAI CSAM Image Classifier — free detection of new and AI-made abuse images
items.summary: A free OpenAI classifier helps safety teams find new and AI-generated child abuse images that hash matching misses.

items.title: OpenAI embedded assessments — four outside labs get inside access to test safety
items.summary: OpenAI lets four independent safety groups work on-site with its checkpoints, training data and monitoring systems.

items.title: California sues OpenAI — state says its agents' Hugging Face attack was foreseeable
items.summary: California's attorney general is suing OpenAI over the agent attack on Hugging Face and says OpenAI misled the public about its testing controls.

items.title: Hunyuan Hy4 Flash — Tencent's cheap 1M-context model for everyday work
items.summary: Tencent's Flash-tier Hy4: a small-active MoE with a 1M-token context, built to make everyday agent work cheap and fast.

items.title: Anthropic cuts its bug disclosure window to 30 days — AI finds bugs too fast
items.summary: Anthropic's Frontier Red Team shortens its coordinated vulnerability disclosure deadlines because AI now finds the same bugs much faster.

items.title: GTIG AI Threat Tracker — attackers now run fully autonomous exploit agents
items.summary: Google's quarterly AI threat report says fully automated patch-to-exploit attacks are now happening in the wild.

items.title: Ask Maps — itineraries, route tips and appointment booking
items.summary: Google's Ask Maps now plans trips, warns about route details and books local appointments.

items.title: US remote-access chip rule — overseas data centers need a license to serve China
items.summary: Renting US AI chips through a data center abroad now needs the same license as buying them, if the customer is Chinese.

items.title: SkillEvaluator 0.9 — NVIDIA's agent-skill tester adds budgets and version diffs
items.summary: SkillEvaluator 0.9 runs your agent with and without a skill, then shows if the skill helped and what the run cost.

items.title: Apple Health AI Usage Study — an OpenEvidence app for 200,000 iPhone users
items.summary: Apple tests how people trust and use AI health answers, with a study app built on OpenEvidence.

items.title: LoopForge — Tencent's self-hosted workflows for coding agents
items.summary: Tencent's open-source workspace turns a team's delivery process into agent workflows with human sign-off.

items.title: RUMOR — FT: Jensen Huang weighs a return as Nvidia CEO
items.summary: FT sources say Jensen Huang weighed a comeback as Nvidia CEO; a CNBC source says the board is not considering it.

items.title: Steve Blank: What's Next for Nvidia? — Visionary CEO or operator
items.summary: Steve Blank looks at Nvidia's CEO search through the history of Microsoft and Apple.

items.title: Qwen4-Max — Alibaba's Qwen4 flagship is live on the API at $1.50 / $4.50
items.summary: Alibaba's first full Qwen4 model goes live on the API, cheaper than the Qwen3.8-Max it replaces.

items.title: GPT-6 Astra and the Standard Model — a candidate lattice definition
items.summary: A physicist credits OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra with leading the proof behind a proposed lattice version of the Standard Model.

items.title: Wes Roth — 'Claude just changed EVERYTHING...'
items.summary: Wes Roth walks through Anthropic's recent Claude changes and what they say about the company before its IPO.

items.title: Sebastian Raschka — understanding positional embeddings in modern LLMs
items.summary: Sebastian Raschka walks through how LLMs know where each token sits, with RoPE explained step by step in PyTorch.
